prompt: Client wants an AI-powered analytics dashboard. They have some data in spreadsheets and want to ask questions about it in natural language. Should be fast. Budget is tight.

assertions.name: produces-pdf
assertions.description: A PDF file exists in the outputs directory

assertions.name: covers-all-sdlc-stages
assertions.description: WBS covers all 6 SDLC stages: Discovery, Design, Development, QA, Deployment, Maintenance

assertions.name: module-level-granularity
assertions.description: Items are at module level not task level

assertions.name: evaluates-multiple-approaches
assertions.description: At least 2 distinct technical approaches are analyzed with tradeoffs

assertions.name: technical-feasibility-present
assertions.description: Feasibility assessment exists for major requirements

assertions.name: brand-compliant-no-red
assertions.description: PDF uses ZenLabs brand colors and does not use red for risk/error indicators

assertions.name: challenges-vague-brief
assertions.description: The CTO challenge identifies specific gaps in the vague brief — missing requirements, unclear scope, unspecified tech constraints
